policy.evidence_policy: Reviewed structural survey of stored content value encodings. Every count is exactly recomputed from config/main.json with the standard library; patches are never applied, served bytes are never produced, and no content validity, gameplay parity, or normalization is claimed.
policy.count_note: Counts are exact recomputations over all entries, never samples. Per-field profiles record JSON-level type distribution plus string-encoded-number, embedded-JSON-string, empty-string, and null counts. Object keys record value-shape distributions instead of field profiles.

string_encoded_number.description: A string counts as a string-encoded number only if it fully matches the numeric grammar: optional sign, digits with optional fraction or leading-dot fraction, optional decimal exponent. Surrounding whitespace, hex, thousands separators, and Infinity/NaN spellings never match.

embedded_json_string.description: A string counts as an embedded-JSON string only if the standard-library JSON decoder parses it. The predicate is independent of the numeric grammar: plain numeric strings, the string null, and whitespace-padded JSON all count; empty strings never count.

array_keys.name: items
array_keys.notes: Fully string-encoded: every present value is a string except cost_type, which is null in all 778 entries. 41 of 53 fields are string-encoded numbers in every entry; costs, inventory_ids, properties, and premium_upgrade_costs carry embedded-JSON containers (objects/arrays/quoted nulls), 1697 container values in total. Empty strings appear only in best_against (299), group_type (46), premium_upgrade_costs (639), and properties (1).

array_keys.name: expansion_prices
array_keys.notes: Fully native: all four fields are JSON numbers in every entry; no strings, nulls, or containers.

array_keys.name: levels
array_keys.notes: Mixed key with homogeneous fields: name and reward_type are strings in all 100 entries, exp_required and reward_amount are numbers in all 100 entries. No string-encoded numbers, embedded JSON, empty strings, or nulls.

array_keys.name: neighbor_assists
array_keys.notes: Mixed key: action, notification, and task are strings; rnd is a number; reward is an object with numeric coins/cash/xp in all 5 entries.

array_keys.name: town_prices
array_keys.notes: Fully native: cash, coins, and level are JSON numbers in all 4 entries.

array_keys.name: map_prices
array_keys.notes: Fully native: cash, coins, and level are JSON numbers in all 4 entries.

array_keys.name: findable_items
array_keys.notes: Mixed key with homogeneous fields: id and coins are numbers, title and description are strings in all 10 entries.

array_keys.name: goals
array_keys.notes: Mixed key with homogeneous fields: id and reward are numbers, title, description, and hint are strings in all 91 entries. hint is empty in all 91 entries.

array_keys.name: offer_packs
array_keys.notes: Mixed key: 10 numeric fields, name and type strings, and items which is an array of id cross-references in 43 entries and null in 1 entry. type is empty in 18 entries.

array_keys.name: social_items
array_keys.notes: Mixed key with homogeneous fields: id and worker_cost are numbers, description and workers are strings in all 26 entries. description is empty in all 26 entries.

array_keys.name: sounds
array_keys.notes: Fully string-encoded: all 6 fields are strings in all 139 entries, and id, loops, max, and preload are string-encoded numbers throughout.

array_keys.name: collections
array_keys.notes: Fully string-encoded: all 6 fields are strings in all 10 entries. cashPrice and id are string-encoded numbers; item_ids and prize carry embedded-JSON arrays/objects.

array_keys.name: level_ranking_reward
array_keys.notes: Mixed key: cash and level are numbers and units is an object mapping item ids to quantities in all 50 entries.

array_keys.name: darts_items
array_keys.notes: Mixed key: id and extra_item are numbers, items is an array of item ids, and start_date is a datetime string in all 30 entries. Stored start_date values are derivation input for make_dynamic, not served values.

array_keys.name: magics
array_keys.notes: Mixed key with homogeneous fields: area, description, img_name, and name are strings; cash, gold, id, level, mana, and target are numbers in all 10 entries. area carries an embedded-JSON array string.

object_keys.name: categories
object_keys.notes: All 6 values are objects with integer id, string name, and a sub array of {id, name, parent} entries (5, 4, 5, 4, 1, 3 entries respectively).

object_keys.name: inventory_items
object_keys.notes: All 90 values are objects with the same 7 string fields (id, name, cashPrice, droppable, dropRate, dropsFrom, description); every value is string-encoded including the numeric ids and prices.

object_keys.name: globals
object_keys.notes: Mixed value shapes: 62 integers, 4 floats (MARKET_INCREMENT, MARKET_SELL_PERCENTAGE, LIMIT_PER_LEVEL_SILO, REACTIVATE_WONDER_DISCOUNT), 8 strings (comma-separated lists, a URL, a date, and one embedded-JSON object string DEPOT_LIMITS), 8 objects (constant maps), and 22 arrays (numeric schedules and reward tables, some nesting objects).

object_keys.name: images
object_keys.notes: All 607 values are the locale string en; each key is the asset path.

object_keys.name: units_collections_categories
object_keys.notes: All 20 values are objects with integer category_id/cost/position/rewards, localized category_name_* strings (category_name_el is empty in every entry), a units array of integer item ids (89 total), and costs which is a numeric array in 19 entries and null in 1 entry.
